nodes.title: The owner's entity edit in the backend
nodes.summary: Everything the edit-entity operation needs in the backend, from the REST request to the attributes, operator note and curation action that an accepted edit records.

nodes.title: Curation backend and its attribute-write collaborators
nodes.summary: The backend area where the owner's entity edit lands, namely the curation module, the ingestion attribute-validation and succession code it borrows from, and the REST and MCP wiring around them.

nodes.title: Apply an entity edit as one whole
nodes.summary: The edit service checks, decides and records every change of one edit inside one transaction and answers the node, the action and each applied change.

nodes.title: Decide each accepted change's effect
nodes.summary: Each change that passed the checks is assigned the effect its rules state, from the node's live attributes of its key.

nodes.title: Check a change's key and value against the catalog
nodes.summary: A change whose key the node's type does not hold, or a set change whose value its key does not accept, is refused with the code the contract states.

nodes.title: Check the validity a change states
nodes.summary: A change that states a validity its key does not accept, or a start that is not strictly before its end, is refused with BUSINESS_TEMPORAL_INCOHERENT.

nodes.title: Publish edit-entity over REST alone
nodes.summary: The authenticated REST route that takes an entity edit and answers it in the shape the entity-editing contract states, with no language-model tool exposing it.

nodes.title: Register the entity edit's refusal codes
nodes.summary: The error codes the entity-editing contract adds, each rendered with the HTTP status the contract gives it.

nodes.title: Validate the shape of an entity edit request
nodes.summary: The request schema that accepts a well-formed entity edit and refuses a malformed one with the validation-format answer.

nodes.title: Read edit-entity actions on the audit surface
nodes.summary: The audit listing reads and filters curation actions of kind edit-entity alongside the other kinds.

nodes.title: Record a correction
nodes.summary: A correction supersedes the attribute it names and records the new attribute naming it as the one it supersedes, carrying its provenance and the edit's fragment.

nodes.title: Record the edit's curation action
nodes.summary: An accepted edit records one curation action of kind edit-entity on the edited node, carrying the reason and the applied changes.

nodes.title: Record a first value or an addition
nodes.summary: A first value or an addition is recorded as a new active attribute at confidence 1.0 under the edit's run, pointing at the edit's fragment and holding the validity start its rules state.

nodes.title: Record the edit's operator note and its run
nodes.summary: An edit records an operator LLM run, one raw information of source type other holding the reason, one chunk and one accepted fragment whose text is the reason.

nodes.title: Record a removal
nodes.summary: A remove change rejects the attribute it names, marking it deleted and stamping its supersession time, and touches no other attribute.

nodes.title: Record a succession
nodes.summary: A succession supersedes the attribute it names, closes that attribute's validity where its rule says, and records the new attribute naming it as the one it supersedes.

nodes.title: Leave disputed attributes to curation
nodes.summary: A change naming a disputed attribute and changing it is refused as disputed.

nodes.title: Refuse an edit of a node that is absent or not active
nodes.summary: An edit naming no held node, or a node whose status is not active, is refused with the code the contract states.

nodes.title: Refuse a change made from a stale form
nodes.summary: A change that names no live attribute of its key, or that adds a second current value to a key that allows only one, is refused as a conflict.
